title: Kurubushi Kyoudai Gekijou Daiikkan: Mahjong-hen
native_title: 踝兄弟劇場 第一巻 麻雀篇
overview:
The Kurubushi Brothers' rivals, the Kakato Brothers, appear!! This one we absolutely want to win! A story mode with a harmony woven by weird yet cute characters! An oddly ultimate thinking routine. A title recommended even for middle-aged guys!! With this, chatting with young people will be a breeze.

Kurubushi Kyoudai Gekijou Daiikkan: Mahjong-hen is a four-player style mahjong game starring the odd, hand-drawn Kurubushi Brothers characters. Sit down at the table against the cast and play hands of mahjong, with a story mode that strings comic scenes between the games.

- Mahjong against the Kurubushi Brothers cast
- Story mode with comic interludes
- One player

踝兄弟にライバル踵兄弟出現！！これは、絶対勝ちたい！怪しくもかわいいキャラ達のおりなすハーモニー、ストーリーモード！なぜか究極の思考ルーチン。おっちゃんにもお奨めのこの一本！！若者との会話もこれでばっちりなのだ。
